headline: Central Bank of Ecuador Hosts Gold Mining Training Workshops
summary: The Central Bank of Ecuador organized training workshops for 157 mining sector actors in Azuay, El Oro, and Zamora Chinchipe to facilitate access to the Gold Commercialization Program.
why: Central bank gold commercialization initiatives regulate domestic mineral trade and formalize precious metals supply chains.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Training workshops facilitate compliance and participation in official gold commercialization programs.
